mcq.question: Given `long long seat_fee_cents(Cabin cabin = Cabin::economy, bool extra_legroom = false, bool window = false);`, how do you request a window seat in economy without extra legroom?

options.C: `seat_fee_cents(Cabin::economy, false, true)` – defaults can only be skipped from the right

mcq.explanation: C++ has no keyword arguments for ordinary function calls, so every parameter before the one you set must be supplied. A parameter struct with designated initialisers avoids this.

mcq.question: What is required for `book_flight("LHR", "JFK", 5540, {.cabin = Cabin::premium, .bags = 2})` to compile in C++20?

options.A: `BookingOptions` must have a constructor taking every member
options.B: The members must all be public static
options.C: Designated initialisers must name every member
options.D: `BookingOptions` must be an aggregate and the designators must appear in member declaration order

mcq.explanation: Designated initialisers work on aggregates, may omit members (they keep their defaults), but must follow the order in which the members are declared.
